what_was_built.database: migrations/0015_consent_records.sql: consent_subject (user_id -> pseudonym uuid mapping) + consent_record append-only ledger (pseudonymous subject, scope, action granted/withdrawn, consent_version, source, device, capture_mode, stroke_intent, recorded_at, monotonic seq). UPDATE/DELETE on consent_record rejected by trigger consent_record_append_only; withdrawal is a new appended row, never a mutation.
what_was_built.shared_types: packages/shared-types/src/consent.ts: ConsentScope (video_analysis | model_training), ConsentAction, sources, capture modes, consent versions, ConsentRecord, deriveConsentStatus(), isModelTrainingConsentActive(). No record => inactive; latest action by seq decides state; scopes are independent.
what_was_built.api_contracts: ConsentGrantRequest / ConsentWithdrawRequest / ConsentStatusResponse Zod schemas + OpenAPI paths POST /v1/me/consent/grant, POST /v1/me/consent/withdraw, GET /v1/me/consent/status.
what_was_built.api: services/api/src/modules/consent/routes.ts: authenticated grant/withdraw/status wired in app.ts. Responses expose the pseudonym, never the app user id. model_training withdrawal flags active user-sourced ml_dataset_item rows and queues ml_dataset_review removal review. Typed errors: validation.consent_grant, validation.consent_withdraw, consent.db_unavailable (503) — no silent fallbacks.
what_was_built.training_gate: services/media-worker/src/trainingConsent.ts: hasActiveModelTrainingConsent(pool, userId) and selectTrainingEligibleItems(pool) fold the latest model_training ledger action per subject; absent consent or withdrawal => ineligible; re-grant restores eligibility. This is the hook any future training selection must call.
what_was_built.mobile: apps/mobile: ConsentSettingsScreen (Data & consent) reachable from Settings > Privacy, RootNavigator route ConsentSettings, consentStore (zustand) + consentApi client. Model-training toggle defaults OFF, disabled unless a server ledger status proves state, neutral copy both directions, failed requests never keep an optimistic toggle, signed-out state shares nothing.

measured_evidence.media_worker_tests: services/media-worker vitest: 2 files, 8 tests passed, including trainingConsent.test.ts (no consent => ineligible, grant => eligible, withdrawal => ineligible, selector filtering, re-grant restores).

measured_evidence.typecheck: pnpm typecheck clean for @pickle/shared-types, @pickle/api-contracts, @pickle/database, api, media-worker.

honest_negatives: Preexisting failure unrelated to C10: services/api test/training.integration.test.ts 'derives streaks from qualifying drill completions' fails with training.completion_in_future on the current wall clock; reproduced on a clean baseline (git stash) before my changes. No production training pipeline exists yet; selectTrainingEligibleItems is the gate future selection code must go through, but nothing calls it in production yet by design.
Consent screen UI verified by jest component tests only; no iOS/Android device run on Linux.
